title: "I'm having doubts in Islam... What do I do?"
normalized_text: assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh I hope you're having a good day I don't usually make videos like this but I felt that it would be appropriate for this topic I've gotten this question a few times during the past year and felt that perhaps it would be best if I recorded an audio answering this and sharing it with all of you the question goes something along the lines of hey I'm having doubts in this town what am I supposed to do or I keep watching YouTube videos against Islam how do I make the doubts stop well there are three approaches to this sort of thing I believe it the vast majority of people simply couldn't care less about information that conflicts with their beliefs they just don't care they shrug it off but you're not that type of person I'm guessing that because you've clicked on this video and you seem to be the type that gets eaten up by this stuff that's probably why you're here for answers then comes the third type of people who are naturally inquisitive but won't let these things eat them and won't cause them doubts why it's because they do the research and most of the time they do find the answers if you happen to be in the second group then you do want to be in the third you will want to learn the Arabic language and you want to familiarize yourself with the classical sources instead of having to rely on secondhand information you'll want to do these things because you're not the type that ignores arguments you're naturally curious I'm somewhat similar by the way I'm inquisitive and honestly I don't think I'd be exaggerating if I've said that I've watched and read more criticisms against Islam then you have but here comes the question that you might be thinking of which is shouldn't I farid be filled with doubts no not really before carrying on I'd like you to be aware that I'm a very open-minded person I've been challenged hundreds of times and I've made changes to my ideology due to those challenges those that do know me will testify that I'm an open-minded the critical person and yet I'm not drowning in doubt after countless hours of going through anti-islamic content so what is a secret well it's a simple one really my foundations are stablished and due to that I'm not bothered by random arguments imagine your best friend who couldn't hurt a fly was convicted of a crime you know for a fact that there was some sort of mistake if there was a witness you would simply believe that the witness was mistaken if there was DNA evidence that your friend was at the crime scene you would accept that your friend was there but perhaps due to some sort of coincidence you would need overwhelming evidence to make you change your mind since it is established in your heart that your friend could never do such a thing the same applies to any set of beliefs your religion may be a fortress that cannot be shaken or it could be a house of cards that falls at the sight of a single allegation let me share with you an example of a fortress during the sixth year after the migration to Medina the Prophet peace be upon him and his companions traveled to Mecca with the intention of visiting the Kaaba to perform Thumba when they got close the Meccans prevented them from entering the city instead a peace treaty was signed and the Muslims had to return back to Medina naturally the Muslims were very disappointed by the outcome however was this seen as a false prophecy for those whose faith hangs on a threat this may have been sufficient for Islam to be considered false however to a Muslim whose faith is built like a fortress like the Sahaba the event was disappointing but ultimately there was nothing more than just a hiccup there were no cases of apostasy and the Muslims returned to Mecca and performed their rituals the very next year this is the mentality that you should have build that fortress learn why Islam is true study the proofs for Islam is the evidence for Islam and for the Prophet peace be upon him sufficient when you are at that stage you will stop caring about the petty evidence against Islam you won't feel the need to binge-watch criticisms against the religion now don't get me wrong I'm not telling you to stop being a critical person however your mentality will change if you stumble upon a question that you cannot answer you will realize that it isn't necessary for you to know what the answer is now since you're aware that a good answer exists elsewhere since the religion is true several years ago I myself came across a doubt that I've never seen anyone bring up I struggled with myself to find an answer I made many phone calls to many people I looked up to and could not get a satisfying answer and I thought to myself I can't believe that I've thought of something that nobody else has and nobody has an answer to him by the way the doubt has to do with Heidi the sciences I recall driving on the highway thinking only negative thoughts about the countless scholars who did not address the specific concern that I had then I stopped and thought to myself who the heck are you you fatigued you are a nobody you're just a punk kid who learned a thing or two and who read a few books you don't know jack know your place and let it go and that's what I did and subhanAllah one day I downloaded a completely irrelevant audio lecture and the chef giving the lecture randomly starts off the lecture with a 30-minute explanation of the doubt I had in mind It was as if my patience and humility was being rewarded so let's get back to the initial issue you're having doubts in Islam and due to this you're going online to watch videos critiquing Islam even more what if you find an answer after searching for a while you decide to watch another video critiquing Islam and you expose yourself to a new matter that you've never heard of and the cycle is endless you've been like that for days maybe weeks maybe months and now you're just tired let me remind you about something if you want to get into refuting every single doubts then I strongly recommend learning the Arabic language and familiarizing yourself with the classical texts if you don't have the time or intention to do so then I strongly recommend doing one thing which is to solely focus on the proofs for Islam you see it's impossible for the proofs for and against Islam to both be correct if the proofs that are for are correct then by default the proofs against are going to be false that's all you need to remember and that is all you need to make all the petty arguments seem irrelevant and that's all I have for you tonight have a good night wassalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh
